title: [Advisory] Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): Critical Remote Code Execution, Patch Now
summary: Security updates and technical details are now available for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938). Calif has demonstrated remote code execution in widely deployed Java applications, including attacks without authentication against Keycloak, Jira, Confluence and Jenkins. Organisations should urgently identify affected deployments and apply security updates or the documented temporary mitigation.
